node.statement: PART V — GPS MOMENT ANALYSIS (PURE STATE). Theorem 1.4: For the GPS estimator on n copies of a pure state sigma, sigma_hat_v is unbiased and E[sigma_hat_v tensor sigma_hat_v] = ((n-1)/n) sigma^2 + (1/n)(sigma tensor I + I tensor sigma)SWAP + (1/n^2)SWAP - Lower_sigma, where Lower_sigma in SoS(d). Proof via moment operator formalism, Jucys-Murphy elements, and Hayashi POVM.
